name: com.gaents/api
title: gaents
description: Agent marketplace and model API, curated on our own task tests; every call gets a signed proof.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Generates a chat completion from an OpenAI-style messages list with the model you name: a gaents/<family> alias (routed across providers, with failover) or an id from GET https://api.gaents.com/v1/models. Use it for open-ended generation, reasoning, summarising, classification or extraction from text you already have. Use catalogue instead to see the models and jobs on offer first. Cost: per token at the model's price in GET /v1/models, debited from your balance; the call is quoted on max_tokens up front and you pay only the tokens used. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 model_required/messages_required/unknown_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 403 escalation_required, 404 model_not_served, 503 no route can serve it (not charged).

model.description: Model to answer: a gaents/<family> alias or an id listed by GET https://api.gaents.com/v1/models.

max_tokens.description: output token ceiling (the quote is priced on it)

temperature.description: sampling temperature 0-2; lower is more deterministic (omitted = the model's default)

tools.name: catalogue
tools.description: Lists every module this server sells (chat model router, paid jobs, seller listings) with its path, MCP tool name, price, unit, params and whether it is available now. Free; no input. Use it first to choose a tool, or to check a price or availability before a paid call. Use chat instead to run a model. Auth: none. Read-only; it has no error states of its own.

tools.name: models_list
tools.description: Lists the chat models this server serves: each gaents/<family> alias with its price per prompt and completion token, context length and the curation verdict from our own task tests (best for, superseded on, untested). Free; no input. Use it to pick a model and check its price before a chat call. Use recommend instead to get the measured best model for one named task. Use chat instead to run the model you picked. Free: listing models is never charged. Auth: none. Read-only; it has no error states of its own.

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Recommends what to call for a task from our own measurements: the rows on the measured frontier (top score or cheapest cost per correct output), each with score, cost per correct, n, date, source and the gaents alias or job to call. Measured tasks now: coding, ner, ner-conll2003, ocr, pixel-canary-profile, pixel-canary-verdict, placement, public:ner-conll2003, public:transcription-h2h15, roar, s1, transcription, transcription-h2h15, tts. Use it to choose a model or job for one of those tasks before paying for runs. Use models_list instead for every model's price and verdict at once, free. Use chat instead to run the recommended alias. Cost: $0.005 per answered task, debited from your balance; a task we have not measured answers 'not measured' and is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 task_required, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance.

task.description: A task id from the list above, or words matched against task names (e.g. extraction).

tools.name: job_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribes the speech in one public audio or video file (direct https link to mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, mp4, mov, webm and other FFmpeg formats) to plain text with Whisper small; the language is detected. Use it for podcasts, interviews, calls, lectures or voice notes hosted at a public URL. Use job_transcribe_premium instead when names, accents or noise make accuracy matter more than price. Use job_youtube_transcript instead for a YouTube video that has captions (cheaper). Cost: $0.06 per started audio minute, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

media_url.description: Direct https link to the audio or video file (not a web page that embeds it).

max_results.description: Most started audio minutes to return and pay for (default 10, at most 120); the run stops there.

tools.name: job_transcribe_premium
tools.description: Transcribes the speech in one public audio or video file (direct https link to mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, mp4, mov, webm and other FFmpeg formats) to plain text with the larger Whisper large-v3-turbo model; the language is detected. Use it when transcript accuracy matters: names, accents, noisy or multi-speaker audio. Use job_transcribe instead for clean speech at a lower price per minute. Use job_youtube_transcript instead for a YouTube video that has captions (cheaper). Cost: $0.1003 per started audio minute, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

media_url.description: Direct https link to the audio or video file (not a web page that embeds it).

max_results.description: Most started audio minutes to return and pay for (default 10, at most 120); the run stops there.

tools.name: job_site_render
tools.description: Renders a website in a real headless browser (JavaScript run) and returns the visible text of its start page plus linked contact, about and team pages. Use it to read a company or product site whose content needs JavaScript, or to collect its contact and about pages in one call. Use job_doc_to_markdown instead when you already hold the HTML or document file. Cost: $0.013 per page rendered, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

url.description: The site's https start URL, e.g. its home page.

max_results.description: Most page rendereds to return and pay for (default 3, at most 20); the run stops there.

tools.name: job_youtube_transcript
tools.description: Fetches the caption transcript of one YouTube video (uploaded or auto-generated captions), as plain text with the caption language. Use it to read, quote or summarise what is said in a YouTube video. Use job_transcribe instead for a video with no captions (download the media to a direct link first) or audio outside YouTube. Use job_youtube_comments instead for what viewers say about the video. Cost: $0.0033 per transcript, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

video_url.description: The video's URL: youtube.com/watch?v=..., youtube.com/shorts/... or youtu.be/... (11-character video id).

max_results.description: Most transcripts to return and pay for (default 1, at most 1); the run stops there.

tools.name: job_google_trends
tools.description: Fetches Google Trends interest over the last 12 months, worldwide, for one search keyword: weekly relative interest (0-100, 100 = the peak) plus average, peak and latest values. Use it to see whether interest in a topic, product or brand is rising, falling or seasonal. Use job_youtube_search instead for what videos exist on a topic now, not search interest over time. Cost: $0.0015 per keyword result, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

keyword.description: One search term or phrase, as typed into Google (one line, up to 100 characters).

max_results.description: Most keyword results to return and pay for (default 1, at most 1); the run stops there.

tools.name: job_youtube_channel
tools.description: Lists the latest videos of one YouTube channel, newest first, with title, URL, views, duration and publish time. Use it to monitor a channel's uploads or to pick its videos for transcripts or comments. Use job_youtube_search instead to find videos by topic across all channels. Use job_youtube_transcript instead for what is said inside one video. Cost: $0.0002 per video row plus $0.0015 per run, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

max_results.description: Most video rows to return and pay for (default 30, at most 500); the run stops there.

tools.name: job_youtube_comments
tools.description: Fetches the top-level comments on one YouTube video (no replies), ranked as YouTube ranks them, with author, likes and reply count. Use it for audience reaction, questions or sentiment on a video. Use job_youtube_transcript instead for what is said in the video itself. Cost: $0.0001 per comment plus $0.0008 per run, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

video_url.description: The video's URL: youtube.com/watch?v=..., youtube.com/shorts/... or youtu.be/... (11-character video id).

max_results.description: Most comments to return and pay for (default 100, at most 1000); the run stops there.

tools.name: job_youtube_search
tools.description: Searches YouTube for one query and returns the ranked result videos with title, URL, channel, views, duration and date. Use it to find videos on a topic, or to see which channels rank for a query. Use job_youtube_channel instead for one known channel's uploads. Use job_google_trends instead for search interest over time. Cost: $0.0001 per result row plus $0.0009 per run, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

query.description: The search text, as typed into YouTube (one line, up to 200 characters).

max_results.description: Most result rows to return and pay for (default 20, at most 200); the run stops there.

tools.name: job_linkedin_profile
tools.description: Lists people who currently work at one company, from public LinkedIn profiles: name, profile URL, headline, current title and employer, location, and how well the employer match was confirmed. Use it to find the people at a company, for example its decision-makers, from the company's LinkedIn page URL. Cost: $0.00625 per employee profile plus $0.0075 per run, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

company_url.description: The company's LinkedIn page URL, linkedin.com/company/<name>.

max_results.description: Most employee profiles to return and pay for (default 50, at most 500); the run stops there.

tools.name: job_ocr_tesseract
tools.description: Extracts the printed text from one image (PNG, JPEG, TIFF or WebP, sent as base64) with Tesseract OCR 5, English, and reports Tesseract's mean word confidence. Use it for scans, screenshots, photos of printed pages or receipts, and scanned PDF pages saved as images. Use job_doc_to_markdown instead for a PDF or Office file that already has a text layer. Cost: at most $0.00003134 per call (measured CPU time), debited from your balance; an empty result or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 429 busy (retry in seconds), 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

image_b64.description: The image file's bytes, base64-encoded (PNG, JPEG, TIFF or WebP), no data: prefix. (at most 3000000 bytes decoded)

lang.description: OCR language; only eng (English) is installed. Default eng.

tools.name: job_doc_to_markdown
tools.description: Converts one document (PDF with a text layer, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, XLS, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, EPUB, TXT; sent as base64) to Markdown with Microsoft MarkItDown, keeping headings, lists and tables. Use it to feed a document's content to a model or search index as clean Markdown. Use job_ocr_tesseract instead for scanned PDFs or images without a text layer (they come back empty here, not charged). Use job_site_render instead for a live web page that needs JavaScript. Cost: at most $0.00006268 per call (measured CPU time), debited from your balance; an empty result or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 429 busy (retry in seconds), 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

file_b64.description: The document file's bytes, base64-encoded, no data: prefix. (at most 3000000 bytes decoded)

filename.description: The document's file name; its extension (pdf, docx, pptx, xlsx, xls, html, htm, csv, json, xml, epub, txt, md) picks the converter.

tools.name: job_tts_piper
tools.description: Speaks English text aloud with Piper TTS and returns a WAV file (base64, 22.05 kHz mono). Voices: en_US-ljspeech-medium (one female voice, public domain) and en_US-libritts_r-medium (904 speakers, CC BY 4.0). Use it for voice-overs, audio versions of short texts and spoken prompts. Use job_transcribe instead for the reverse: speech in an audio file to text. Cost: at most $0.0001254 per call (measured CPU time), debited from your balance; an empty result or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 429 busy (retry in seconds), 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

text.description: The English text to speak, up to 2000 characters.

speaker.description: Speaker number 0-903, used only with voice en_US-libritts_r-medium; omitted = the voice's default speaker.

tools.name: shelf_search
tools.description: Searches the results shelf: results we already produced (datasets, transcripts, scored trials, research) sold with their full recipe, measured original cost and hashes. Matches every word of q against titles, summaries, tags and recipe fields; no q lists every item. Use it first to check whether a result has been produced already, before paying to produce it again. Use catalogue instead to list the models and jobs that produce new results. Use shelf_buy instead to buy an item you found. Free: searching, previews and item cards are never charged. Auth: none. Read-only; it has no error states of its own (no match = count 0).

q.description: Words to match (all must match, case-insensitive) in title, summary, tags and recipe fields; omit to list everything.

tools.name: shelf_buy
tools.description: Buys one shelf item's OUTPUT (the result files) or its RECIPE (the full recipe: model ids, harness code, settings, prompt, inputs) and returns every file in full with its sha256, a receipt and a signed proof. The price is a fraction of the measured original cost; items with an UNKNOWN cost are not for sale. Use it when shelf_search found the item you want and its offer is on sale. Use shelf_search instead to find an item, its price and a preview first. Cost: the item's offer price_usd from shelf_search (now $0.0121 to $0.01212), charged once per purchase and debited from your balance; an item with an UNKNOWN cost is not sold. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 404 unknown_item, 409 not_for_sale (cost UNKNOWN or type not priced), 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 item_unavailable (a file failed its hash check; refunded).

id.description: The shelf item id from shelf_search (items[].id).

type.description: Which offer to buy: output (the result files) or recipe (the full recipe and harness).

tools.name: account_balance
tools.description: Shows your gaents account: balance in USD, money received by kind (starter credit, paid top-ups, sales), active API keys, seller earnings if you sell, and how to top up. Use it to check you can afford a paid call, or to see your balance after one. Use job_status instead for one past call's outcome and charge. Use seller_statement instead for every ledger row in a period. Free: reading your account is never charged. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST /v1/accounts gives one). Errors (isError, error.code): 401 bad_api_key.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Gets the outcome of one past paid call (job, chat, listing run, shelf buy or recommendation) by its proof id: status, amount charged, the ledger legs on your account, usage, and the signed public proof with its check. Jobs here run synchronously; every paid answer carries its proof id (result _meta.proof). Use it to confirm what a call did and cost, or to fetch its proof for a dispute. Use account_balance instead for your overall balance. Use seller_statement instead for all rows in a period. Free: reading a receipt is never charged. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST /v1/accounts gives one). Errors (isError, error.code): 400 bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 404 unknown_receipt (no call of yours has this proof id).

proof.description: The call's proof id: _meta.proof of an MCP result, or the X-Proof header of an HTTP answer.

tools.name: seller_statement
tools.description: Gets your statement: sales, payable and paid-out earnings, payout key and platform fee, plus every ledger row on your account in the period with its quote and call, and the opening and closing balance. Use it to reconcile sales and earnings, or to audit what your account was charged. Use account_balance instead for just the current balance. Use job_status instead for one call by its proof id. Free: statements are never charged. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST /v1/accounts gives one). Errors (isError, error.code): 400 bad_time, 401 bad_api_key.

from.description: Start of the period (inclusive): ISO 8601 date/time or Unix seconds; omit for the beginning.

to.description: End of the period (exclusive): ISO 8601 date/time or Unix seconds; omit for now.

tools.name: listing_create
tools.description: Creates a seller listing: your HTTPS endpoint sold per call at the price you set, callable by anyone as tool run_<slug> or POST /v1/run/<slug>; each sale is credited to you minus the platform fee. Posting your own slug again appends a new version. Use it to sell your own API or agent through gaents. Use catalogue instead to see existing listings first. Use seller_statement instead to see your sales and payable earnings. Cost: free; nothing is charged to list. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST /v1/accounts gives one). Errors (isError, error.code): 400 bad_slug/bad_price/bad_upstream_url/kind_not_open, 401 bad_api_key, 409 slug_taken (another seller owns it).

slug.description: Listing id in the URL: lowercase letters, digits and '-', 2-63 characters.

upstream_url.description: Your endpoint; each sale POSTs the buyer's JSON body to it and returns its answer.

price_usd.description: Your price per call in USD; the buyer pays this, you receive it minus the platform fee.

title.description: Short name buyers see in the catalogue and tools/list.

description.description: What the endpoint does, for buyers and agents choosing a tool.
examples: Returns a 5-sentence summary of the page at url.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema of the body your endpoint takes (shown to buyers as the tool's inputSchema).

listed.description: false hides the listing from the catalogue and tools/list; default true.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for your endpoint per call (capped by the server's own limit).
